profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at ZoomInfo
profile.summary:
Over 20 years software engineering experience in diverse areas including data analytics, bioinformatics algorithms and embedded electro-mechanical systems. R&D, manufacturing, and healthcare experience. Start-up experience building complete IT infrastructures and technology development teams.

Specialties: • Java, C#, C++, JavaScript, HTML, R, Matlab, JSP, Struts, Apache, PHP, ASP, VB, IIS, ASP.NET, MFC, SQLite, Oracle, SQL Server and MySQL on Windows, Macintosh and Linux for web and desktop applications. 
• Understand qPCR, SNP, miRNA, TaqMan, SYBR, LIMS, MES, digital PCR and Capillary Electrophoresis.
• Practiced agile and test-driven development, build and test automation.
• Work complied with IEC 62304, ISO 13485:2003, ISO 14971:2007

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Building a highly scalable data processing pipeline using Cassandra, Hadoop, Solr, Spring, Hibernate, Nutch, Java, Python and SQL Server.  Analyzing Salesforce data to improve customer close, retention and acquisition rates.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Applied Natural Language processing algorithms in a scalable EC2-based data processing pipeline that extracts/cleans/factors web content into a generalized data model. 
• Analyzed AWS cloud health, BI and applied machine learning algorithms to customer purchase data to improve recommendation engine algorithms and web UI using Java, Python, MySQL, NumPy, SciKit, Splunk and Django.

positions.title: Senior Java Algorithm Developer
positions.description:
• Developed new and maintained existing algorithms for analyzing PCR/CE instrument data in Java, R and Matlab including:
  • Filtering, normalizing and spectrally un-mixing fluorescence data
  • Model fitting and dynamic programming algorithms for matching measured to expected results
  • Curve Fitting, quantification
  • Quality testing and reporting
• Implemented web-based LAMP interface to the gene sequence search tool ThermoBLAST 
• Worked included full development lifecycle from translation of user needs into business requirements, technical specifications and design documentation
• Managed software development for an FDA approved Clostridium difficile detection assay. Work complied with
  • IEC 62304 Medical Device Software Life Cycle Processes
  • ISO 13485:2003 Medical Devices Quality Management Systems and 
  • ISO 14971:2007 Medical Device Risk Management

positions.title: Software Engineer, Software Engineering Manager
positions.description:
• Developed or managed the development of bioinformatics algorithms and instrument-control software in C++, Java, R, Matlab and C# for genomic research. 
Embedded electro-mechanical systems include a flood-illumination thermocycler and reagent transfer robots. 
Applications include pathogen detection, miRNA analysis, digital PCR, qPCR expression analysis and SNP genotyping. Bioinformatics algorithms include cluster analysis, threshold cycle calculation, melt-curve analysis, melting temperature determination, starting quantity determination, standard curve analysis, amplification-curve baseline determination, spot-finding and integration. 
• Developed manufacturing execution system tools integrated with qPCR analysis instruments and robotic reformatting systems. Worked in the lab with scientists, field application, hardware engineering and manufacturing teams.  
• Selected, deployed and managed information systems for Web applications, version control, database, content management and defect tracking systems. Hired and managed scientists, editors, IT, DBA, software development and SQA engineers. 
• Managed development of Java software for tandem mass spectrometry (MS/MS) instrument for multiple generations of RapidFire product (now a part of Agilent Technologies).
• Transitioned from startup company BioTrove, Inc. through purchase by Life Technologies in 2009.

positions.title: Principal Consultant
positions.description: Improved data analysis for the Massachusetts General Hospital Endocrine unit.

positions.title: Director of Informatics
positions.description:
• Grew a MGH bioinformatics group to support $43M in grant-funded research at 20 centers nationwide including level-one trauma centers, genomic and proteomic research centers.
• Developed and managed development of a laboratory information management system that stores information from genomic experiments. Developed another Web-based laboratory information management system integrated with a clinical study data management system linking 20 research centers nationwide, including level-one trauma centers, genomic and proteomic research centers.
• Managed software development including the specification, implementation, testing, deployment, and maintenance of web and desktop applications. 
• Selected, deployed and managed information systems for web applications, version control, database, content management and defect tracking systems. 
• Hired and managed software developers, SQA engineers, database and IT administrators, editors, marketers, designers, and scientists.

positions.title: Director of Advanced Development
positions.description:
• Directed software development instrumental in winning new business; managed the specification, implementation, testing, deployment, training and maintenance of software applications. Managed lifecycle of multiple software versions.
• Programmed algorithms, user interface, printing engine, document management and business logic in C++ in Windows and Macintosh cross-platform desktop applications. Extensive use of MFC.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Programmed user interface, simulation engine and business logic in C++.

positions.title: SQA Project Manager
positions.description: Managed five-person team testing a Windows drawing program.

volunteerExperiences.description:
• Head coach of a six student First Lego League robotics team. In each of our four seasons we succeeded at qualifying tournaments to reach the state championship. The team received numerous first and second place awards each season. I received a 2014 Adult Coach/Mentor Award. 
• Currently assistant coaching on a First Tech Challenge robotics team.
